title: Police Teach Irresponsible Mom a Lesson She Won’t Forget
description:
On February 21st, 2024. A worried woman called 911 after noticing that a 2-year-old was out on the street screaming. The woman then took the child up to the apartment and saw several other children left alone in that apartment. The mom arrived on the scene and started going ballistic on the police and the woman who helped her.
